_comment: ccds Gate-2 deny rules (ADR-0013): harness-enforced deny for the model's FILE TOOLS (Read/Edit etc.). Honest scope: these do not govern Bash subprocess reads (cat .env) - that stays with the ccds-guard hook's ask - nor replace OS-level sandboxing. Mirrors plugin-extras/ccds-guard/hooks/guard-rules.txt deny-paths INCLUDING its allow-list: .env templates (.env.example/sample/template/dist) and *.pub keys are deliberately NOT denied here, so live env variants are enumerated instead of wildcarded. When guard rules change, change this file in the same PR (test_settings_deny_mirrors_guard_rules is the tripwire).
